evidence.title: Kálmán Rózsahegyi
evidence.text: Kálmán Rózsahegyi( 6 October 1873, Pest- 27 August 1961) was a Jewish Hungarian actor and teacher.

evidence.title: Kálmán Rózsahegyi
evidence.text: He descended from a family of theatre actors; his father, Ödön Rózsahegyi performed in the countryside.

evidence.title: Kálmán Rózsahegyi
evidence.text: Kálmán Rózsahegyi also began his career performing in the countryside, but in 1898 he was hired by the Hungarian National Theatre.

evidence.title: Kálmán Rózsahegyi
evidence.text: Between 1900 and 1935 he was a member of the National Theatre, from 1923 as a permanent member.

evidence.title: Kálmán Rózsahegyi
evidence.text: With his wife, Angéla Hevesi, he founded his own private drama school, which was the place of learning for many famous actors.

evidence.title: Ernest Torrence

evidence.title: Maximus of Tyre
